author: BerrySmooothie
body:
Hi guys,

So how this game works is I will start off with a sentence and then the next person will 
have to type the exact same thing, but not looking at the keyboard AND closing their eyes.
Then, the next person has to type the exact same thing that the person above wrote,
whether or not they spelled it right. 

Let's see what we will end up with!
Have fun! and do not cheat.

THE STARTING SENTENCE:

A wave loudly clashing against a long shoreline is always a pleasure especially when its 12:00 in the afternoon
